title: fraxinus urophylla
intro: Fraxinus urophylla, commonly known as the Fiddleleaf Ash, is a deciduous tree species native to China and Southeast Asia. The Fiddleleaf Ash has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce blood pressure, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Fraxinus urophylla include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cardio-protective properties, which may help to improve cardiovascular health and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The bioactive constituents of Fraxinus urophylla include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
